title: File:Cyclone Michaung in the Bengal Gulf (Copernicus).jpg
desc: Cyclone Michaung is the 6th named storm of the 2023 North Indian Ocean cyclone season. It is expected to make landfall on 4 December on the east coast of the Indian Peninsula, where an orange cyclone alert has been issued for the provinces of Andhra Pradesh and adjoining North Tamil Nadu-Puducherry.
